projectName: Animate bubble sort, comparison by comparison
accountBinding: Fresh stage upload through existing account. Import the graphics composition separately in Graphics. This recipe transfers no owner, credential, Storage path, credits or render.

steps.title: Open an empty stage
steps.control: Choose videos → algorithm-stage.mp4 → Open Creator Studio → Reframe
steps.value: 16:9; Preserve frame; Rounded main footage off; preview captions off; source sound and voice repair off
steps.why: The stage has no finished animation. The native layers and timeline supply the concept demonstration.

steps.title: Import editable graphics
steps.control: Graphics → Import animated graphics → Import graphics composition…
steps.why: The composition expands to ordinary editable artwork, text, groups and keys. It is not a pre-rendered animation.

steps.title: Inspect the layers and fixed labels
steps.control: Graphics → Titles / Vector artwork; Motion → Target layer
steps.value: Inter text; rotation 0; opacity 1; native rectangle geometry; exact layer sizes and timings in the parameter tables below
steps.why: Separate labels from animated values. A teacher or learner can correct wording and state without rebuilding a movie elsewhere.

steps.title: Reproduce a motion endpoint
steps.control: Composite → Graphic groups → Element 5 · card + value → Curve keyframe
steps.value: x · 4.250s; Selected group key value = 17; Selected group key easing = Ease In Out
steps.why: This is an actual group-property key. The percentages are offsets from the original layer positions, not absolute slot coordinates.

steps.title: Trace the full timeline
steps.control: Edited output position; Play comparison; pause before each transition
steps.value: Programme seconds 0–28; follow the exact layer timing and property-key tables
steps.why: Predict each concept state before watching it. A smooth animation must still represent the correct algorithm or query.

steps.title: Save, export and inspect
steps.control: Save project → Export → Export resolution / Export frame rate → Render Final Clip
steps.value: 720p; 24 fps; H.264; AAC if narration is added; one normal render after account confirmation
steps.why: Save the editable project separately, then download and review the entire movie. Local proof does not guarantee every production route.
